body: Suresh, aapke Mylari South Indian Cafe ke profile views last 30 days mein 12400 hain, jo Indiranagar mein category average se 158.3% upar hai. Corporate bulk thali package ke liye, hum aapke existing Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 ko base bana sakte hain. Ismein, 10+ orders par ek special bulk rate offer kar sakte hain. Kya main is structure ke saath ek draft post bana doon?

Padma, your click through rate is 6.2%, well above the 4.5% peer average. For the kids yoga summer camp, I’ve drafted a four week, three sessions per week program for ages 7 to 12 at ₹2,499 per child, plus an optional add on of your First Month @ ₹499 for parents who enroll. Shall we lock in this plan and schedule the launch?

Hi Aditya 😊, this is Karim from Karim's Salon. I noticed your last visit was on 1 April and you’ve only been once with us so far. We’re launching a Haircut @ ₹99 offer tomorrow. Reply with YES to book the ₹99 haircut tomorrow.

Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu se namaste 😊 Aapka last visit 1 April ko tha, aur aap humare salon mein ab tak 2 baar aaye hain. Kal aapka appointment scheduled hai, aur hum aapke favorite service ko ensure karna chahte hain. Kya aap haircut ya hair spa prefer karenge?

Ramesh, ORS demand is up 40% this summer per the Multi pharmacy aggregate Apr 2026. Given your high repeat customer rate and the Free Home Delivery > ₹499 offer, moving ORS, sunscreen and antifungal creams to the counter while shifting cold cough meds to the back shelf can capture the surge. Shall I draft that shelf rearrangement plan for you?

Meera, your profile logged 2,410 views in the past 30 days, 32% above the peer average, though the click through rate sits at 2.1% versus 3% peers. The IDA Delhi: Digital impressions, 2026 state of the art session, with Dr. R. Mehta on 2 May 2026, offers 2 credits and is free for members, a solid fit for enhancing digital workflow for your high risk adult cohort. Shall I reserve your spot?

Namaste 💊 Mr. Sharma, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy se. Aapka last visit 22 Apr 2026 tha aur metformin, atorvastatin, telmisartan ki refill 28 Apr 2026 tak khatam ho jayegi. Senior citizen ke liye 15% off aur ₹499 se upar free home delivery aapke saved address par. Kya aap delivery confirm karna chahenge, Yes ya No?

Vivaan, 😊 this is Bright Smile Dental. Your last visit on 2026-04-01 marked your 5th appointment with us. To keep your oral health optimal, we recommend a professional cleaning (scaling) and a quick fluoride varnish check. We have a Dental Cleaning at ₹299. Would you like to book a slot this week?

Dr. Meera, Smile Studio opened 1.3 km away offering Dental Cleaning @ ₹199. Your Dental Cleaning @ ₹299 remains higher priced yet your profile views are 32% above peers and you logged 18 calls last month, showing strong local interest. I can draft a focused Google post that highlights your superior cleaning service and the 124 high risk adult patients you serve. Shall I send it over?

Suresh, aapke profile views pichle 30 din mein 12400 the, jo peer average 4800 se 158% zyada hai aur click through rate 3.2% hai, peer 2.5% se. Zomato verified badge se impressions 24% tak badh sakti hai. Main ek corporate bulk Lunch Thali offer ka draft bana sakta hoon, bas aapko pack size aur pricing preference chahiye. Kaunsa pack size aap target karna chahenge?

Lakshmi, aapke Studio11 Family Salon ke profile views last 30 days mein 4980 the, aur calls bhi category average se 121.4% upar hain. Kapra mein abhi kaun si service ki sabse zyada demand hai, jaise Haircut @ ₹99 ya Hair Spa @ ₹499 ke alawa? Aap batayenge toh main us par ek GBP post bana dungi.

Suresh, your click through rate is 3.2% versus the 2.5% peer average. With 12,400 profile views in the last 30 days and 4,200 unique customers YTD, the Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 is pulling solid footfall. I can draft a corporate bulk Thali package that keeps your table turnover high and fits your reservation flow. What key details (e.g., typical group size or preferred pricing) should I include?

Rashmi, this is PowerHouse Fitness. It’s been 57 days since your last session on Feb 28, and we miss seeing you chase your weight loss goals. 🎯 We’d love to get you back with our active offer of 3 FREE trial classes, no commitment needed. Would you like to book them for this week?

Reyansh, 😊 this is Asha Dental Care. We noticed it’s been a while since your last visit on 2026-04-01 (5 visits total). We’re introducing a Dental Cleaning for ₹299 and would love to schedule you. Which date works best for you?

Reyansh, Daily Care Medicos yahan se. Aapka last visit 2026-04-01 tha aur aapke 12 visits humare liye important hain. 😊 Hum aapke liye ek naya Free BP & Sugar Check offer la rahe hain. Kya aap is week aane ka plan bana rahe hain?

Anjali, your click through rate is 2.2% versus the 4% peer average. With 380 unique customers YTD and 180 lapsed over 90 days, a targeted offer could lift both views and calls, especially as “balayage near me” searches are up 45%. I can draft a simple “Haircut @ ₹99” promo or a “FREE head massage with Haircut” campaign in under 30 minutes. Which promo would you prefer to launch first?

Anand, your profile saw 2,189 views in the last 30 days, well below the 4,800 peer average. In Sector 8, Chandigarh, your 1,525 unique customers could be nudged with a fresh promo. I can draft a Flat 30% OFF offer (₹500 cap) and a quick post, just need your go ahead on the discount. Which promo sounds best for you?

Hi Lakshmi, aapke Studio11 Family Salon ke profile views last 30 days mein 4980 rahe hain, jo Kapra ke average se double se bhi zyada hai. Wedding industry intel ke according, abhi April May ek mini bridal window hai, jisme pre wedding skincare aur mehendi prep services ki demand badhti hai. Aapka Hair Spa @ ₹499 offer already active hai. Kya main aapke liye ek 'Bridal Trial @ ₹999' offer ka draft bana doon?

Pooja, your profile views jumped to 5,934 last 30 days, 440% above the gym peer average. With the upcoming festival, boosting footfall via a fresh trial offer can offset the low acquisition window (Apr to Jun). I’ll draft a ‘3 FREE Trial Classes’ promo tailored to your Koramangala crowd; just tell me the weekday slot you’d like to push.

Vikas, your Sunrise Medicos profile in Gomti Nagar isn’t verified yet, and verified listings in pharmacies see about +30% uplift in discovery. Your click through rate is 4.1% (above peer 3.8%) but profile views are 720, 48.6% below the category average. We can walk you through the postcard or phone call verification path. Shall I send it over?

Suresh, DC vs MI at Arun Jaitley Stadium kicks off 26 Apr 19:30. Your 30 day profile views are 2,200, 54% below peers, and the current Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free runs Tue to Thu, missing the weekend match surge. I can draft a match day post to extend the offer for 26 Apr, just approve the copy. Shall I send it?

Suresh, you’ve hit 145 reviews, just 5 shy of the 150 review milestone. With your weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 pulling strong footfall and a 3.2% CTR (28% above peers), a quick QR code review prompt on receipts could push you over. Shall I draft the QR code card and short copy for you?

Mukesh, your CTR is 5.3%, 112% above the category peer average. Yet profile views this month are only 787, 83.6% below peers, so there’s room to pull more footfall to Pizza Spot in Aundh. I can draft a “Flat 30% OFF on total bill (up to ₹500)” offer for you to review; just let me know the headline you prefer. Shall I send it over?

Dr. Bharat, calls fell 50% week over week, dropping to 4 from a baseline of 12 in the past 7 days. Your profile views are 980, 46% below the peer average, and the Google Business Profile remains unverified. I can draft a Dental Cleaning offer @ ₹299 and complete the profile verification for you. Shall I set this up now?

Sushma, your click through rate is 5.8% versus the category average of 4%. With 2,547 profile views in the last 30 days and 1,454 unique customers YTD at your Baner, Pune salon, there’s room to lift call volume. I can put together a simple Hair Spa @ ₹499 offer draft to attract more callers, just need your OK on the headline. What headline would resonate best with your clients?

Padma, your calls rose 15% week over week, matching the recent kids yoga post boost. Congrats on the momentum; with 95 active members and a 6.2% CTR, a focused kids yoga flyer could lock in even more footfall. I can draft a ready to post kids yoga summer camp flyer (4 week, 3 classes/week) for you to review. Shall I send it over?

Vikas, your click through rate of 4.1% for Sunrise Medicos in Gomti Nagar is already 7.9% above the category peer average. However, your profile views are 720, well below the average. Setting up an offer like 'Free Home Delivery > ₹499' could help. Shall I draft this offer for you?
Priya, Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic se namaste! 😊 Aapka 6 month cleaning due hai (last cleaning 12 May) ₹299. Available slots: Wed 5 Nov at 6pm or Thu 6 Nov at 5pm. Kripya inme se ek choose karein.

Hi Diya, from Zen Yoga Studio! We noticed it's been a while since your last visit on April 1, 2026. We've missed your presence and the energy you bring! To help you restart your practice, we're offering your First Month @ ₹499. Would you like to know more?

Dr. Meera, the Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04 revises radiograph dose limits effective 2026-12-15. This means maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops to 1.0 mSv, affecting your X ray setup at Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic in Lajpat Nagar. E speed film passes, but D speed does not. Shall I send a quick audit checklist for your X ray setup?
